description: This file contains an abstract class implementation for building and managing headers in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides mechanisms for header validation, setting, removing, and building immutable header objects. The class handles various types of headers such as correlation IDs, schema versions, authorization contexts, response types, content types, entity tags, and metadata headers, with some methods marked deprecated indicating evolving API design. The class uses design patterns like method chaining and validates headers against known definitions, ensuring header correctness before building an immutable representation.

classes.name: AbstractDittoHeadersBuilder
classes.description: An abstract class that provides a base implementation for building and validating headers in the Eclipse Ditto framework, supporting method chaining and handling various header types, including metadata, authorization, and content headers.

methods.name: correlationId
methods.description: Sets the correlation ID header value.

methods.name: schemaVersion
methods.description: Sets the schema version header value.

methods.name: replyTarget
methods.description: Sets the reply target header value.

methods.name: expectedResponseTypes
methods.description: Sets expected response types in the headers.

methods.name: putStringCollection
methods.description: Stores a collection of strings as a JSON array in the headers.

methods.name: timeout
methods.description: Sets a timeout header based on a Duration or custom parser.

methods.name: putMetadata
methods.description: Adds a metadata header key-value pair.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs an immutable headers object after validation.
